aliases: AXIS Q6000-E PTZ Dome Network Camera
sensor: 4 x 1/2.8" progressive scan RGB CMOS (2 MP)
field_of_view_deg: 152 horizontal, 85 vertical per sensor (113 horizontal in default 4:3 mode)
features: Mounts with any AXIS Q60-E PTZ camera for one-click PTZ control (Solo version works stand-alone)
Shock detection and active tampering alarm
Dedicated RJ45 port for the AXIS Q60-E camera plus service port
release_notes: Specs per official Axis datasheet (ds_q6000e_1476543_en_1512.pdf). Datasheet covers AXIS Q6000-E and Q6000-E Solo; weight/height are for Q6000-E (Solo: 4.20 kg, 213 mm). Typed panoramic: it is a 360 degree overview unit with no pan/tilt/zoom of its own. Auto-matched sheet was the Q6000-E Mk II datasheet; replaced.

frigate.notes: Standard Axis VAPIX RTSP path; not yet verified on this model.

home_assistant.notes: Native Axis integration with auto-discovery via Zeroconf.
